scope: Synthetic and temporary-file software behavior, not ECU compatibility.

threshold.metric: equal bytes at identical offsets divided by equal nonzero file size
threshold.invalid_thresholds: Rejected; invalid CLI input does not create an index.
threshold.limits: Pairwise explicit file comparison only, not corpus-wide candidate retrieval, rank_score normalization, probability, project identity or ECU compatibility. Padding and short files may inflate similarity.

metadata.conflicting_identifiers: Reported independently of byte similarity; a 95 percent synthetic pair remains semantically inconclusive.
metadata.parser_warnings: Exposed separately in project and Workbench candidate results.
metadata.pagination: Partial metadata candidates are ranked before pagination; deterministic tie breaking is tested.
metadata.coverage: Existing positive, negative, missing-metadata, inconclusive, repeatability and explanation regressions passed in the isolated subset.

precision_recall: NOT_MEASURED: no independently labelled compatibility dataset.
